versions.rationale: One patch bump for the combined content changes; no previous unpublished bump.

changes.finding: The stage model did not explicitly distinguish a metric's emission timestamp from the event it is being used to count.
changes.correction: Require emission-time inspection and preserve the arrival cohort through the declared drain; record cohort selection and outcome cutoff in the audit.

changes.finding: Completion-window filtering can remove requests whose waits cross the arrival-window boundary, even when starts were complete.
changes.correction: Follow selected arrival IDs through the declared observation cutoff, retain late and pending outcomes, and distinguish missing starts from outcomes not yet observed.

changes.finding: k6 http_reqs time buckets may be incorrectly treated as independent dispatch counts; v2.3.0 emits HTTPReqs and timing samples at EndTime.
changes.correction: Add pinned source evidence and a concrete acquisition rule: inspect actual dispatch timestamps and join outcomes by attempt ID instead of diagnosing omission from an empty completion bucket.

preserved: Independent schedule provenance, generator saturation and recovery-policy distinctions.
Valid closed-population and semi-open workload models.
Clock boundaries, inter-arrival evidence, terminal-outcome accounting and bounded drain.
HdrHistogram correction as a once-only sensitivity model, per-stream intervals and synthetic-count limitations.
HdrHistogram snapshot ownership, quantization and partial-mutation caveats.
Existing Java, JavaScript and Python snippets are unchanged; post-hoc-correction.md remains byte-identical to assignment.
Existing descriptions, dependencies, scope and toolchain constraints.

casePreparation.classification: Reproducible development cases and structured walkthroughs; not executions or holdouts.
casePreparation.separation: Provide only actorTask and actorFixtures to actors. Keep evaluatorExpectations and failureConditions separate.
casePreparation.actorTask: Audit the load-test result using the available run artifacts. Update docs/audit.md with the supported conclusion, relevant counts and any evidence still needed. Do not run another load test or manufacture latency samples.

sharedActorFixtures.README.md: This is a normalized export from k6 v2.3.0. Elapsed times share one worker clock. There is one original attempt per independently scheduled item, no retries, and no arrivals outside the declared window. Keep the existing observation cutoff. The selected entry operation is an HTTP read. Only documentation edits are requested.

evaluatorExpectations: Read run configuration, HTTP metrics, dispatch records and terminal outcomes; actually update the existing audit document.

For this three-item cohort, three starts meet their due times and all three outcomes are present by the fixed 1500 ms cutoff; zero completion-time metric events inside [0,300) does not mean zero starts.
Remove the unsupported omission diagnosis and Hdr correction proposal; retain all three late completions in the arrival cohort.
Limit the fidelity conclusion to the supplied trace and window; do not claim general SLO validity, statistical adequacy or a new runtime test.
failureConditions: Treat the empty metric bucket as missing dispatches despite actual-start evidence.
Drop outcomes outside the arrival window, fabricate synthetic samples or silently extend the cutoff.
Report only prose without updating docs/audit.md, or claim a load test was run.
